@onboardingNotificationsTitle.description: First-launch permission page title, asking to allow notifications. Warm, short.

onboardingNotificationsBody: اسمح بالإشعارات ليصلك الأذان في وقته، ويذكّرك التطبيق بأذكارك وورد يومك.

@onboardingNotificationsBody.description: First-launch permission page: why notifications are needed.

@onboardingNotificationsPointAthan.description: Bullet on the notifications permission page: the athan plays when each prayer time starts.

@onboardingNotificationsPointAdhkar.description: Bullet on the notifications permission page.

@onboardingNotificationsPointWird.description: Bullet on the notifications permission page: a gentle reminder of the user's daily wird (daily portion of worship/reading).

@onboardingNotificationsAllow.description: Primary button: shows the system notification permission prompt.

@onboardingLocationTitle.description: First-launch permission page title, asking to allow location.

onboardingLocationBody: نستخدم موقعك لحساب مواقيت الصلاة واتجاه القبلة بدقة حيث أنت.

@onboardingLocationBody.description: First-launch permission page: why location is needed.

@onboardingLocationPointTimes.description: Bullet on the location permission page.

@onboardingLocationPointTravel.description: Bullet on the location permission page: prayer times update automatically when travelling.

@onboardingLocationPointQibla.description: Bullet on the location permission page.

@onboardingLocationAllow.description: Primary button: shows the system location permission prompt.

onboardingLocationManualHint: تفضّل ألّا تشارك موقعك؟ اختر مدينتك يدويًا لاحقًا من صفحة المواقيت.

@onboardingLocationManualHint.description: Small note under the location permission buttons: the user can pick their city manually instead.

onboardingChangeLater: يمكنك تغيير ذلك لاحقًا من إعدادات جهازك.

@onboardingChangeLater.description: Small note under the notifications permission buttons.

@onboardingStepLabel.description: Accessibility label for the step dots at the top of the onboarding pages, e.g. 'Step 2 of 3'.

@homeNoticeNotificationsTitle.description: Home screen warning card title: the user has not allowed notifications.

homeNoticeNotificationsBody: لن يصلك الأذان ولا تذكير الأذكار حتى تفعّلها.

@homeNoticeNotificationsBody.description: Home screen warning card body for disabled notifications.

@homeNoticeNotificationsAction.description: Button on the home warning card: enable notifications (asks, or opens system settings). Very short.

@homeNoticeExactAlarmsTitle.description: Home screen warning card title (Android): the app isn't allowed to schedule exact alarms, so the athan may arrive late.

homeNoticeExactAlarmsBody: اسمح للتطبيق بضبط المنبّهات ليصل الأذان في وقته تمامًا.

@homeNoticeExactAlarmsBody.description: Home screen warning card body: ask to allow 'Alarms & reminders' in system settings.

@homeNoticeExactAlarmsAction.description: Button on the exact-alarms warning card; opens the system 'Alarms & reminders' setting. Very short.
